# KPI Meter

One key figure for this period next to the same period last year, showing at a glance, and not by colour alone, whether it moved the right way.

## Usage

```html
<r-kpi-meter label="Revenue" value="1285400" previous="1150000"></r-kpi-meter>
<r-kpi-meter label="Costs" value="412000" previous="398000" better="lower"></r-kpi-meter>
```

### The Comparison

The comparison is also exported as a pure function:

```typescript
compareYears(value: number, previous: number, better: 'higher' | 'lower'):
    { change: string; tone: Tone; fill: number; mark: number }
```

- **`change`:** a signed whole percent with a real minus sign: `+12 %`, `−3 %`, `±0 %`. When `previous` is 0 the change is `±0 %`, never infinity.
- **`tone`:** `ok` when the figure moved the way `better` asks for or stayed level, otherwise `danger`.
- **`fill` and `mark`:** this year and last year as percentages of a scale of `max(value, previous, 1) × 1.15`. The headroom keeps either year from looking like a full bar and lets a small difference still show. Neither is ever negative.

The number format follows the [formatting configuration](../Formatting.md), and the "last year" text is the `lastYear` text from the [`r-components` namespace](../Formatting.md#words).

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `string` | | What the figure is |
| `value` | `number` | | This period's figure |
| `previous` | `number` | | The same period last year |
| `better` | `higher \| lower` | `higher` | Whether a rise is good news |

A `value` or `previous` that is not a number, or a `better` other than `higher` or `lower`, reports an error and the meter renders nothing.

## Parts

| Selector | What it is |
|----------|------------|
| `.label` | What the figure is |
| `.figures` | The formatted value and the `.change` |
| `.change[data-tone]` | The change in percent, toned |
| `.bar[data-tone]` | The bar, with `--fill` and `--mark` set to this year's and last year's percentage |
| `.this-year`, `.last-year` | The fill and the mark inside the bar |
| `.previous` | "{previous} last year", under the bar |

## Accessibility

The change is written out as text beside its tone, so the direction never rests on colour.
